title: 95 By BP
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from participants undergoing laser-evoked pain stimulation at four individually calibrated intensity levels, applied to the left and right hand dorsum. Participants rated perceived pain intensity using a numerical rating scale (0-10) following each stimulus, across 80 trials in a two-factor repeated-measures within-subject design. The dataset supports research into the neural correlates of pain perception and intensity coding.
methods_description: Laser stimulation intensity was individually calibrated to each participant's pain threshold using 0.25J increments, with four intensity levels corresponding to NRS ratings of 2, 4, 6, and 8. Stimuli were delivered to the left and right hand dorsum (2 locations x 4 intensities = 8 conditions, 10 trials each, 80 trials total). Participants verbally rated pain intensity after each stimulation using a numerical rating scale from 0 (no sensation) to 10 (maximum tolerable pain).
